name: Power-Assisted Bicycle
description: A bicycle meeting the federal power-assisted bicycle definition, with motors totalling 500 W or less that stop assisting at 32 km/h, operable pedals and an unladen weight of no more than 120 kg; nothing in it excludes a scooter- or motorcycle-style body.

restrictions.rule: Meets the federal power-assisted bicycle definition and bears its manufacturer's label, with pedals that are operable at all times and can propel it on level ground by muscular power alone
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Its definition still points to the federal one, though Canada repealed that in 2021
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Its motors total 500 W or less and can't assist past 32 km/h
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 1(1); Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1038, s. 2(1), before SOR/2020-22

restrictions.rule: Weighs no more than 120 kg unladen, with wheels at least 35 mm wide and 350 mm in diameter
The motor must stop propelling it when pedalling stops, the throttle is released or the brakes are applied, and the battery and motor must be securely fastened
Brakes on both wheels able to stop it from 30 km/h within 9 metres, and all electric terminals insulated and covered
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 64(2); O. Reg. 369/09, ss. 4, 5

restrictions.rule: Must not be ridden if modified to raise its power or speed past the federal limits; removing the pedals makes it a motor vehicle
restrictions.citation: O. Reg. 369/09, s. 6; Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 1(1)
Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 38(1)

restrictions.rule: Every rider must wear a bicycle or motorcycle helmet
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 103.1(2)

restrictions.rule: No passenger unless it's designed to carry more than one person
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 178(2)

restrictions.rule: Not a motor vehicle: no driver's licence, registration, plates or insurance
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Ridden under the rules of the road for cyclists, wherever bicycles are allowed
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. H.8, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Not allowed on the 400-series highways, the Queen Elizabeth Way or the other controlled-access highways listed in Regulation 630
A municipality may ban it from its roads, sidewalks, bike paths, trails or bike lanes by by-law
A cargo e-bike over 55 kg with a motor of up to 1,000 W can instead run under the cargo power-assisted bicycle pilot, where a municipality allows it

The Safer Roads and Communities Act, 2024 repeals this definition and drops power-assisted bicycles from the Act's bicycle and motor vehicle definitions, on a day not yet named by proclamation, so regulations can replace it
restrictions.citation: Safer Roads and Communities Act, 2024, S.O. 2024, c. 21, s. 1

restrictions.rule: An April 2026 Ministry proposal (ERO 026-0422) would split e-bikes into pedal-assist and throttle classes and push scooter- and motorcycle-style ones into the motor vehicle classes; it isn't in force
